title: omni.client._omniclient removed
description: Private internal API removed. Use public omni.client API.

fix.description: Replace import

title: Python 3.10 → 3.11
description: Python upgraded. Audit f-strings, typing module usage, and third-party packages for 3.11 compatibility.

fix.description: Update Python references to 3.11

title: Linux: _GLIBCXX_USE_CXX11_ABI=1
description: Native packages now use new C++ ABI. Rebuild all .so plugins.

fix.description: Rebuild all native plugins against new ABI

title: packman XML: ${platform_target} → ${platform_target_abi}
description: Native packages now use ABI-variant tokens. Update all packman dependency XMLs so the ABI suffix is included in package names.

title: nv_usd → usd nomenclature
description: Replace nv_usd references with standard usd in build scripts and packman XMLs. Use add_usd{} Premake helper instead of linking nv_usd_* libs directly.

title: carb.imgui removed
description: Replaced by omni.kit.imgui.

title: Carbonite Events 2.0 — dispatch model
description: Events no longer need explicit pump calls. Python payload access changed from e.payload['key'] to e['key']. Subscribe via carb.eventdispatcher.get_eventdispatcher().observe_event(). C++: update to carb::eventdispatcher.

fix.description: Update event subscriptions and payload access to Events 2.0 pattern. Remove explicit event pump calls.

title: Fabric PathC/TokenC introduced (removed in 109)
description: Kit 107 introduced PathC/TokenC. Kit 109 removes them. If upgrading 106→109+, skip directly to fabric::Path/Token.

fix.description: Use fabric::Path and fabric::Token directly if targeting 109+

title: Toolbar deprecated APIs removed
description: omni.kit.widget.toolbar and omni.kit.window.toolbar v2.0.0 removed all previously deprecated APIs.

fix.description: Update to current toolbar API

title: Python 3.11 → 3.12
description: Python upgraded from 3.11 to 3.12. Update Premake configs, CI, and build scripts. Audit all third-party packages for 3.12 compatibility. Also update boost_python references.

fix.description: Update Python references to 3.12

title: OpenUSD 24.05 → 25.02
description: All C++ extensions linking against OpenUSD must be rebuilt against the new headers and libraries.

fix.description: Rebuild all C++ extensions against OpenUSD 25.02

title: GfMatrix imprecise overloads removed
description: Deprecated imprecise matrix overloads removed from GfMatrix. Use explicit precision variants.

fix.description: Replace imprecise GfMatrix calls with explicit precision variants

title: Assert macros require explicit carb/Assert.h
description: CARB_ASSERT and related macros previously available via Defines.h now require an explicit #include <carb/Assert.h>.

fix.description: Add #include <carb/Assert.h> where assert macros are used without an explicit include

title: Library.h: functions removed, use macros
description: getDefaultLibraryPrefix() and getDefaultLibraryExtension() removed. Use CARB_LIBRARY_PREFIX and CARB_LIBRARY_EXTENSION preprocessor macros instead.

title: Minimum GPU: Turing (sm_75)
description: Pre-Turing GPU architectures (Maxwell sm_52/53, Pascal sm_60/61/62, Volta sm_70/72) removed from CUDA compilation targets.

fix.description: Retarget CUDA kernels to sm_75+

title: Carbonite 208.2 → 208.3 ABI break
description: Binary ABI break. All extensions compiled against 208.2 must recompile.

fix.description: Recompile all extensions against carb_sdk 208.3

title: ITokens::setValue() → setValueS()
description: Method renamed, now takes std::string_view instead of const char*.

title: carb::detail::defineTupleCommon namespace change
description: detail:: namespace removed.

title: PyObjectVTable type name constant changed
description: Use kPythonVariantTypeName instead of PyObjectVTable::get()->typeName.

title: acquireInterface → getCachedInterface
description: acquireInterface generates verbose log noise. Use getCachedInterface.

title: omni.graph.core 3.0.0 ABI break
description: Binary incompatible with 2.x. Recompile all OmniGraph nodes.

fix.description: Recompile against omni.graph.core 3.0.0. Align omni.graph.nodes version.

title: Parallel OmniGraph node registration removed
description: Extension manager is not thread-safe. Registration is now sequential.

fix.description: Remove parallel registration code

title: omni.kit.extpath.git removed
description: Extension fully deleted.

fix.description: Remove all dependency declarations

title: omni.hydra.scene_api deprecated
description: Deprecated since Kit 108. Removal expected in future version.

fix.description: Migrate away from omni.hydra.scene_api

title: omni.kit.manipulator.prim.fabric no longer default dep
description: Removed from default dependency chain.

fix.description: Declare explicit dependency if needed

title: omni.resourcemonitor no longer loaded transitively
description: Must declare explicitly if used.

fix.description: Add explicit dependency in extension.toml

title: omni.kit.ui no longer loaded transitively
description: omni.ui, omni.kit.property.usd, omni.kit.viewport.window no longer pull in omni.kit.ui.

fix.description: Add explicit omni.kit.ui dependency in extension.toml

title: ILayers ABI 1.0 → 1.1
description: Recompile all extensions including omni/kit/usd/layers/ILayers.h.

fix.description: Recompile against ABI 1.1

title: Layer events migrated to Events 2.0
description: Use carb::eventdispatcher::IMessageQueue instead of carb::events::IEvents.

fix.description: Migrate to carb.eventdispatcher

title: WindowHandle.visible deprecated
description: Returns None in Python. Use Window methods instead.

fix.description: Replace WindowHandle with Window equivalents

title: Menu/Separator menu_compatibility deprecated
description: Add menu_compatibility=False. Parameter removed entirely in Kit 110.

title: get_custom_glyph_code moved to omni.ui
description: Moved from omni.kit.ui to omni.ui.

title: Livestream settings path changed
description: /app/livestream/ moved to /exts/omni.kit.livestream.app/primaryStream.

fix.description: Update settings paths. See config_changes.json for full mapping.

title: omni.kit.livestream split into modules
description: Monolithic livestream extension replaced. Replace omni.kit.livestream with omni.kit.livestream.app + omni.kit.livestream.aov + omni.kit.livestream.core. Replace omni.services.livestream.nvcf with omni.services.livestream.session.

fix.description: Update extension dependency lists in .kit and extension.toml files

title: carb::extras::Path implicit conversion removed
description: Requires explicit .getString() calls. Also: getPathParent/getPathExtension/getPathStem/getPathRelative now only accept string_view.

fix.description: Add .getString() where implicit conversion was used

title: OpenUSD NDR removed
description: Node Definition Registry removed from OpenUSD.

fix.description: Migrate shader/material discovery to alternative USD APIs

title: USD scalar transform ops introduced
description: OpenUSD now supports scalar transform ops (e.g., xformOp:translateX). Code that assumes all transform ops are vector types may behave or iterate incorrectly. Test transform-heavy workflows carefully.

fix.description: Audit loops or type checks over xform ops. Do not assume all ops are GfVec3d/GfMatrix — add handling for scalar variants.

title: carb.events C++: const char* overloads deprecated
description: carb::events API functions now accept std::string_view. Old const char* overloads are deprecated and will be removed in a future release.

fix.description: Update carb::events call sites to pass std::string_view (or carb::cpp::string_view) instead of raw const char*.

title: NumPy 1.x → 2.x
description: Type aliases removed: np.bool, np.int, np.float, np.complex, np.object, np.str. Also: Windows default int size int32→int64; type promotion rules changed; verify all third-party dependencies.

fix.description: Replace with Python builtins or np.bool_, np.int64, etc.

title: CUDA SDK upgraded to 12.4.1 — driver requirement
description: Applications fail to start with older drivers. Linux minimum: 550.54.15. Windows minimum: 551.78. Verify across all dev and deployment environments.

fix.description: Update CUDA toolkit references and verify driver versions on all machines

title: Fabric TokenC/PathC/TokenId/PathId removed + trivially-copyable ABI break
description: Replaced by fabric::Token and fabric::Path. Also: Token/Path are now trivially copyable — binary ABI break requiring recompile even with no source changes. kUninitializedToken/kUninitializedPath removed — use token.isNull() instead.

title: carb::thread::shared_lock removed
description: Use std::shared_lock instead.

title: IDictionary::MakeAtPathS() → MakeAtPath()
description: Method renamed, now returns Item*.

title: compareStringsNoCase() → caseInsensitiveCompare()
description: String comparison function renamed.

title: Logger → Logger2
description: carb::logging::Logger superseded by Logger2. Update custom logger implementations to inherit from Logger2, which receives log messages via a struct parameter.

fix.description: Inherit from carb::logging::Logger2 instead of Logger

title: mergeMaterials default changed
description: Causes silent load time performance regression. Set explicitly to avoid surprises.

fix.description: Set app.renderer.mergeMaterials explicitly in .kit file

title: Fabric Scene Delegate (FSD) enabled by default
description: Test render output carefully if you previously disabled FSD.

fix.description: Test render output. Remove workarounds that assumed FSD was off.

title: mimalloc default allocator (Windows)
description: Cross-DLL heap mismatches may now crash. Use kit-sysalloc.exe for compatibility if needed.

fix.description: Audit cross-DLL memory ownership. Use kit-sysalloc.exe if needed.

title: carb::cpp17/cpp20 → carb::cpp
description: Namespaces merged.

title: DomeLight default orientation changed (USD 25.05)
description: Existing scenes with DomeLight may render differently. Use UpgradeUsdLuxLightsCommand for assisted migration. Check omni:rtx:usdluxVersion attribute and /rtx/usdLux/newLights/compliant setting.

fix.description: Test scenes with DomeLights. Use UpgradeUsdLuxLightsCommand if needed.

title: MDL SDK ABI 56 → 57
description: Binary incompatible. Recompile MDL/Neuray plugins.

fix.description: Recompile against MDL ABI 57

title: CloudXR runtime extracted to new extension
description: New ABI interfaces. XRCloudXRBindings.h removed. OpenXR updated to Khronos 1.1.50.

fix.description: Implement new IOpenXRRuntimeService_v1 ABI. Remove XRCloudXRBindings.h.

title: Clear extscache before upgrading
description: Stale entries cause dependency solver failure (exit code 55).

fix.description: Delete _build/*/release/extscache/ directory

title: OpenUSD 25.02 → 25.11
description: All C++ extensions linking against OpenUSD must rebuild.

fix.description: Rebuild all C++ extensions against OpenUSD 25.11

title: USD displayName/displayGroup/hidden metadata deprecated
description: GetMetadata/SetMetadata with 'displayName', 'displayGroup', 'hidden' keys deprecated on UsdObject/UsdPrim/UsdProperty. Use UsdUI.UsdUIPrimHints API instead.

fix.description: Use UsdUI.UsdUIPrimHints for displayName/displayGroup/hidden access

title: USD file format libs moved: usd/usd → usd/sdf
description: Core format implementations (usda, usdc, usdz) moved to usd/sdf. sdf test format removed — use usda in tests.

fix.description: Update include paths. Replace sdf test format with usda in test code.

title: Hydra 2 rendering backend removed
description: Remove all Hydra 2 settings and code paths.

fix.description: Remove Hydra 2 settings and code paths

title: Multi-node rendering removed
description: Remove multi-node rendering configuration.

fix.description: Remove multi-node rendering settings and code

title: menu_compatibility parameter removed
description: Passing menu_compatibility to ui.Menu/Separator raises TypeError in Kit 110.

title: omni.usd layers API deprecated
description: Use omni.kit.usd.layers instead of context.get_layers().

title: omni.renderer_capture deprecated
description: Use omni.kit.capture instead.

title: CARB_CHECK → CARB_RELEASE_ASSERT
description: CARB_CHECK replaced.

title: IFileSystem raw char* methods removed
description: Use carb::cpp::string_view / std::string alternatives.

fix.description: Replace raw char* IFileSystem calls with string-based APIs

title: ITokens unsafe string extraction methods removed
description: Migrate to ITokens 2.0 (opt in with #define carb_tokens_ITokens CARB_HEXVERSION(2,0)). Use deleteValue() instead of setValue(nullptr). resolveString() now returns omni::expected.

fix.description: Opt in to ITokens 2.0 or update call sites for removed methods

title: carb/Defines.h split into sub-headers
description: Replace monolithic include with specific headers: AlignSize.h, Architecture.h, Compiler.h, Deprecation.h, ImportExport.h, Platform.h.

fix.description: Replace #include <carb/Defines.h> with specific sub-headers

title: kUnicodeToUtf8Failure / kUnicodeToWideFailure removed
description: Sentinel constants removed. Functions now silently insert U+FFFD replacement character on failure instead.

fix.description: Remove comparisons against these sentinel values; handle U+FFFD in output instead

title: g_carbClientName: const char* → zstring_view
description: Type changed from const char* to carb::cpp::zstring_view. Direct assignment or const char* comparison will break.

fix.description: Update g_carbClientName assignments and comparisons for carb::cpp::zstring_view type

title: Deprecated headers removed in Kit 110
description: time/TscClock.h → clock/TscClock.h. omni/core/ReplaceCarbAssert.h → use CARB_RELEASE_ASSERT directly. omni/log/LogChannelFilterUtils.h and WildcardLogChannelFilter.h removed without replacement.

fix.description: time/TscClock.h → clock/TscClock.h; remove ReplaceCarbAssert.h; remove log filter headers

title: optional<bool>/expected<bool> semantics changed
description: if(b) now tests presence, not value. Use b.has_value() && b.value().

fix.description: Replace if(b) with if(b.has_value() && b.value())

title: Extension registry URLs changed
description: Update from Nucleus URLs to Azure blob storage.

title: omni.kvdb removed
description: Silently removed. Causes cryptic dependency solver failure (exit code 55).

fix.description: Remove dependency and find replacement for key-value store needs

title: omni.localcache removed
description: Silently removed. Same cryptic failure class as omni.kvdb.

fix.description: Remove dependency and audit usages

title: omni.genproc.core removed
description: Deprecated. Migrate procedural generation workflows.

fix.description: Migrate to alternative APIs

title: OmniGraph bundle/attribute manipulation nodes deprecated
description: Deprecation warnings now visible in editor (Kit 110.1+). Migrate away from bundle-based workflows. ArrayGetSize→ArrayLength, AttributeType→GetAttributeType, ExtractPrim→ReadPrim, GetAttributeNames→ReadPrimAttributes, InsertAttribute→WritePrimAttribute. BundleConstructor/CopyAttribute/RemoveAttribute/RenameAttribute have no direct replacement — redesign graphs.

fix.description: Migrate bundle-based node workflows to ReadPrim/WritePrim attribute nodes. See api_replacements.json for 1:1 mappings.

title: OmniGraph event and render pipeline nodes deprecated
description: UpdateTickEvent→omni.graph.action.OnTick. GpuInteropCudaEntry→RenderPostProcessEntry (C++ API). RenderPreprocessEntry and RpResourceExample* nodes removed.

fix.description: Replace UpdateTickEvent with OnTick. Replace GpuInteropCudaEntry with RenderPostProcessEntry C++ API. Remove RpResourceExample* nodes.

title: Visual Studio 2022 required
description: Update repo.toml build settings.

fix.description: Set vs_version=vs2022, msvc_version=v143 in repo.toml

title: MaterialX 1.38.10 → 1.39.3
description: Deprecated nodes (ND_swizzle_*) generate warnings. Nodes with parameter changes (ND_atan2_float) may generate errors referencing missing properties — requires active migration.

fix.description: Test MaterialX materials. Fix deprecated/changed nodes.

title: OpenUSD 25.11: Ndr/Sdr libraries consolidated
description: The Ndr and Sdr libraries have been collapsed into a single unified library. Update any #include paths referencing pxr/usd/ndr or pxr/usd/sdr directly.

fix.description: Update #include paths and namespace references from pxr/usd/ndr and pxr/usd/sdr to the unified library headers in OpenUSD 25.11.
